summary: Race-end flow gate. Returns 1 (allow progression) when the short expiration timer at this+0x14 has elapsed (<= 0.0); returns 0 (block) while the hold timer at this+0x1C is still positive. Otherwise, when the current vehicle's finish state (dword_5F073C[4656 * currentIndex], reached through sub_4D1B50(dword_8ACEE0, 0)) equals 1 AND the finished-vehicle count at this+0x20 has reached the player's position threshold (dword_7C54E8 + 16480), the result is set from the player's DSQ/retired flag (dword_7C54E8 + 16484). Finally, if the finished count at this+0x20 equals the vehicle count dword_5C329C, progression is unconditionally allowed.

operations.description: Initialize the return accumulator v2 to 0.
When the float at this+0x14 is <= 0.0 (short expiration timer elapsed), return 1 immediately (allow progression).
When the float at this+0x1C is > 0.0 (hold timer still running), return v2, i.e. block progression.
Resolve the current vehicle index: sub_4D1B50((unsigned __int8*)dword_8ACEE0, 0).

When dword_5F073C[4656 * currentIndex] == 1 (current vehicle finished) AND the dword at this+0x20 >= the dword at dword_7C54E8 + 16480, set v2 to (dword at dword_7C54E8 + 16484 != 0) (player DSQ/retired flag).
result preset to 1; if the dword at this+0x20 != dword_5C329C (finished count != vehicle count) return v2, otherwise return 1 (unconditional progression).
